course.title: Power Plant Engineering
course.department: Department of Energy Science and Engineering

content.value:
. For a hydro-electric power plant, the following data is available: 11   
Annual rainfall: 800 mm   
Catchment area: 150 sq. km   
Head: 200 m   
Yield factor to allow for run-off and evaporation loss: 60%   
Overall efficiency: 75%   
Annual load factor: 45%.   
Determine: (i) Average power produced, (ii) Capacity of the plant.
